title: AI must serve humans, rather than 'become an instrument of domination and injustice', pope warns
content: Pope Leo XIV, who has made AI a central component of his pontificate, warned against the dangers of the technology at  UNESCO.

title: Protests erupt in Granada after eviction of 87-year-old woman in Madrid
content: Protesters gathered in Granada in support of 87-year-old Maricarmen Abascal after she was evicted from her Madrid apartment.

title: Emmanuel Macron and Pope Leo XIV set out clashing world views at first meeting in France
content: Speaking at the Elysée, the pontiff set the tone for his first visit to France; dialogue with the Republic, warnings over AI and a call for peace, while acknowledging ongoing disagreements.
snippet: Speaking at the Elysée, the pontiff set the tone for his first visit to France; dialogue with the Republic, warnings over AI and a call for peace, while acknowledging ongoing disagreements.

title: Watch: Pope Leo XIV warns AI could threaten humanity in ‘paradise of machines’
content: Pope Leo XIV has warned against losing humanity in a “paradise of machines” as artificial intelligence increasingly shapes daily life. During his first papal visit to France, he called for greater ethical discernment and for keeping human beings at the centre of AI discussions.

title: Small businesses in rural France bears the brunt of energy crisis triggered by Iran war
content: In the Oise department, soaring energy prices driven by the war in Iran are hitting rural businesses hard, as they face rocketing bills for heating oil and diesel.

title: Macron denies CIA warned France of Russian drone attack
content: French President Emmanuel Macron denied CIA warnings of a possible Russian drone operation targeting southern Europe and pledged to send "military assets" to "protect" the Yanbu site, a key component of Saudi Arabia's energy infrastructure.

title: EU sanctions former RT France chief Xenia Fedorova over pro-Russian propaganda
content: The Council of the European Union confirmed the Russian commentator had been added to its sanctions list on Thursday. In France, she had already faced an expulsion order and an asset freeze, both of which she challenged.

title: Rutte says Putin is in a 'bad place' as he reassures NATO allies amid threat reports
content: NATO chief Mark Rutte said the alliance was prepared to respond to Russian hybrid attacks against European countries following fresh warnings from Danish intelligence. Meanwhile, US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth urged European allies to take greater responsibility for their own defence.

title: Ukrainian suspect arrested after fatal stabbing at Polish abbey
content: A knife attack at a Catholic abbey in Poland left one person dead and four others injured. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy condemned the attack as a "horrific crime" and called for the perpetrator to be held accountable.

title: What counts as ‘Made in Europe’? France, Germany and Spain are divided
content: France wants a strict EU preference, Germany would include trading partners, while Spain is proposing a compromise as Brussels seeks to counter Chinese competition.
